lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximately five distinct horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, with the central row exhibiting the highest pixel intensity.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect the circular blobs, forming a geometric lattice where each blob serves as a primary nodal intersection point.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the dorsal-lateral flank, defined by a sharp intensity gradient transition from high-luminance upper edges to shadowed lower recesses.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a scattered distribution of approximately 10-15 small, high-luminance blobs, primarily concentrated within the anterior and mid-sections of the fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small irregular notches are visible along the trailing edge of the first dorsal fin, and faint linear white abrasions are present on the posterior flank near the caudal peduncle.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a high-density, stochastic arrangement of smaller high-luminance spots that contrasts with the ordered, lower-frequency grid pattern found on the primary lateral flank.
